scientific_integrity: The finite computations are distinguished from the uniform analytic proof; source inspection and independence limitations are stated without claiming outside certification.
scientific_limitations: Classifies rank-three theories, not full or all rank-four theories. The finite checker tests prime fields in selected dimensions and does not prove the all-field theorem. The rank-three k=2 subcase follows from prior Grassmann adjacency classification; the new field-uniform k>=3 statement and rank-four obstruction are subject to unindexed literature priority risk.
title: Two-point extension universality and a rank-four obstruction for \(q\)-Kneser graphs
